question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "active".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Passive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"active"** refers to someone or something that is full of energy, engaged in activities, or participating enthusiastically. (सक्रिय)

 
 
• **Example:** She is very active in community programs and always contributes her time and effort.
 
 
 
• **"Passive"** is the opposite of "active." It refers to someone or something that remains inactive, does not take initiative, or is not involved in activities. (निष्क्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** He remained passive during the discussion and did not voice his opinion.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word most opposite in meaning to **"active"** is **"passive."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Passive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Energetic** (ऊर्जावान): Refers to someone who is full of energy or vitality.

 
 
• **Example:** She is energetic and always ready to tackle challenges.
 
 
 
• **Agile** (चुस्त): Refers to someone who is quick, nimble, or has the ability to move easily and quickly.
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete's agile movements helped him win the race.
 
 
 
• **Lively** (जीवंत): Refers to someone who is full of life, enthusiasm, or spirited energy.
 
 
• **Example:** The lively music brought joy to everyone at the party.
